headlines: AI/chip rout continues: NVDA -8.2%, MU -14.3%, AMD -14.5%, SNDK -18.5%, TSLA -11%, QQQ -5.5% (Stocktwits trending)
SPY 737 (-3.9%) off the 734 low, bouncing slightly; Stocklake fear and greed 20 (extreme fear); 6.9% of stocks oversold, QQQ RSI ~28
Gold +1.1%, TLT +0.4% as money rotates to safety
US nonfarm payrolls tomorrow 13:30 UTC (prior 29, unemployment prior 4.2); Mexico rate decision 19:00 UTC today

rumors.text: Posters say the selloff is forced selling by over-leveraged institutions holding AI names
rumors.why: Forced liquidation could overshoot, then reverse

rumors.text: Posters say SPY is being driven into the 200-day average and a break could extend the fall
rumors.why: Breaking a key moving average can trigger more technical selling

rumors.text: A poster claims Marco Rubio is to resign
rumors.why: Single unverified post; if true would add political uncertainty

plays.reason: Down about 4% in one day, extreme fear 20, QQQ RSI under 30 and some bounce off the low; oversold bounces are common but payrolls tomorrow is a risk
plays.catalyst: Oversold bounce vs payrolls 13:30 UTC tomorrow

readings.whats_new: SPY recovered slightly to about -3.9% from -4.2% last hour, off the 734 low; chip losses eased a little (NVDA -8%, MU -14%, AMD -14.5%). Fear and greed still 20 and Stocktwits SPY sentiment 34 (up from 29). Chatter now centers on forced institutional selling and the 200-day average; Reddit blocked and web search found no same-day coverage.
